skill.name: lark-base
skill.description: Guides agents through Lark Base tables, fields, records, views, forms, dashboards, workflows, roles, and safe lark-cli routing.
skill.summary: Operate Lark Base resources with command routing, structured JSON guidance, and safety checks.
skill.author: larksuite

security_audit.summary: The static findings are false positives caused by Markdown command examples, relative documentation links, placeholder URLs, and high-entropy Chinese reference text. I found no prompt injection phrases, encoded payloads, executable scripts, or malicious data-exfiltration intent in the reviewed files. The main operational risk is normal for this skill: it guides agents to use lark-cli against user-authorized Lark Base resources.

remediation.issue: Markdown command examples trigger shell execution heuristics.
remediation.suggestion: Keep examples clearly fenced or described as user-authorized lark-cli usage, and avoid wording that implies automatic execution without user intent.

remediation.issue: Relative cross-skill links trigger path traversal heuristics.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer marketplace-safe reference names or normalized local documentation links where possible.

remediation.issue: Dense Chinese text and long JSON examples trigger obfuscation heuristics.
remediation.suggestion: Split very long examples into shorter sections and keep placeholders human-readable to reduce false positives.

content.user_title: Manage Lark Base Tables and Workflows
content.value_statement: Lark Base work often requires exact command routing, IDs, and JSON shapes. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through safe Base operations with lark-cli.
actual_capabilities: Resolves Base links or titles into usable Base, table, view, record, form, dashboard, and workflow IDs.
Routes table, field, record, view, form, dashboard, workflow, and role tasks to the correct lark-cli shortcuts.
Provides reference guidance for field JSON, cell values, formulas, lookup fields, filters, and data-query DSL.
Supports Base data analysis workflows that use server-side filtering, grouping, aggregation, sorting, and Top N queries.
Guides form submission, dashboard component configuration, workflow step design, and role permission updates.
Redirects authentication, authorization, and file import tasks to the appropriate Lark shared or drive skills.
limitations: Requires lark-cli to be installed and authorized for the target Lark workspace.
Needs real Base tokens, table IDs, field names, and returned IDs; it should not guess identifiers.
Does not import local Excel, CSV, or .base files directly; those tasks route to Lark Drive import tools.
Does not replace user permission checks, confirmation gates, or workspace access controls.

use_cases.title: Maintain Operational Tables
use_cases.description: Create fields, update records, configure views, and keep Base data aligned with team workflows.

use_cases.title: Analyze Base Data
use_cases.description: Run server-side filters, aggregations, and Top N queries before summarizing business results.

use_cases.title: Administer Forms and Permissions
use_cases.description: Manage forms, dashboards, workflows, custom roles, and advanced permission changes with confirmation steps.

prompt_templates.title: Resolve a Base Link
prompt_templates.prompt: Resolve this Lark Base link, identify the available tables, and tell me which IDs are needed for the next step: <base_url>

prompt_templates.title: Add Records Safely
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this Base and table to add these records. First confirm the field structure, then write only supported storage fields: <base_url> <table_name> <records>

prompt_templates.title: Create an Analysis View
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the top customer segments by revenue in this Base. Use server-side query or filters, then create a view if the result should be reused: <base_url>

prompt_templates.title: Design Workflow and Roles
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Base workflow and role requirement. Propose the needed workflow steps, role changes, and confirmation points before making changes: <requirements>

output_examples.input: Find the sales table in this Base and show the top regions by revenue.
output_examples.output: The skill resolves the Base, confirms the sales table and revenue field, runs a server-side aggregation, and returns the ranked regions with query scope.

output_examples.input: Add a required feedback question to an existing Lark Base form.
output_examples.output: The skill identifies the form, reads current questions, prepares the new question, and asks for confirmation before changing the form.

output_examples.input: Create a dashboard for monthly order trends and category share.
output_examples.output: The skill lists tables and fields, selects suitable chart blocks, creates components in sequence, and can request a dashboard layout arrangement.

best_practices: Resolve Base links and titles before running commands, and keep returned IDs for follow-up steps.
Read table and field structure before writing records, formulas, lookup fields, filters, or dashboard data configuration.
Use server-side Base queries for global counts, aggregations, sorting, and Top N results.
anti_patterns: Do not treat wiki tokens, workspace tokens, or full URLs as Base tokens.
Do not write system, formula, lookup, or attachment fields as ordinary record values.
Do not answer global analysis questions from one default record page or local filtering alone.

faq.question: Does this skill need lark-cli?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill documents lark-cli Base shortcuts and assumes the CLI is installed and authorized.

faq.question: Can it import Excel or CSV files into Base?
faq.answer: No. It routes file import tasks to Lark Drive import commands, then returns to Base operations after import.

faq.question: Can it work from a shared Base URL?
faq.answer: Yes. It first resolves the URL to the correct Base token and related IDs before continuing.

faq.question: How does it handle permission errors?
faq.answer: It routes authentication, scope, identity, and authorization recovery to shared Lark guidance instead of guessing credentials.

faq.question: Can it create formulas and lookup fields?
faq.answer: Yes. It requires the relevant formula or lookup guide before building the field request.

faq.question: Does it support dashboards and workflows?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes routing and reference guidance for dashboard blocks, chart data, workflow steps, and role permissions.
